execution_definition: Each P0 claim was researched against current official, institutional or specialist sources. Claims were not accepted automatically; remote evidence was not used as an engineering or legal substitute.

sources.title: Impact on cultural heritage — Gaza
sources.scope: Remote and rapid on-site damage verification for named cultural properties; no public site-by-site engineering severity grade.

sources.title: State of Conservation of the Old City of Jerusalem and its Walls, reporting period 2025
sources.institution: Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan and State of Palestine, submitted to UNESCO
locators: pp. 45–53: Western surroundings, Waqf properties, excavations and Silwan
pp. 60–63: City of David, Pilgrimage Road and Silwan tunnel network
sources.scope: Attributed state-party reporting on access, Waqf administration, excavations and physical-landscape concerns; not an independent adjudication of all legal or engineering claims.

sources.title: State of Conservation Report — Hebron/Al-Khalil Old Town, reporting period 2025
sources.institution: State of Palestine, Hebron Rehabilitation Committee and Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities
locators: pp. 5–18: conservation, access and maintenance restrictions
pp. 20–21: Tell Rumeida excavations begun 11 June 2025
sources.scope: Current conservation activity and attributed threats within the World Heritage property and buffer zone.

sources.title: Birzeit historic-centre revitalization
sources.scope: Historic-centre boundary, inventory and conservation context; does not independently establish the identity or date of a castle.

sources.title: Nablus restoration programme
sources.institution: Old City of Jerusalem Revitalization Programme / Taawon
sources.scope: Restoration of selected façades across Old Nablus quarters, including Al-Yasmina; not a complete condition survey.

sources.title: Herodium Park
sources.scope: Published visitor access and opening hours; does not close the full archaeological chronology or Palestinian rights questions.

sources.title: Palestinian locality classification
sources.scope: Lists Deir Samit and Al Karmil as distinct Hebron Governorate localities, disproving their treatment as one canonical place.

sources.title: Ramallah and Al-Bireh localities — Sinjil
sources.scope: Confirms Sinjil belongs to Ramallah and Al-Bireh Governorate, not Nablus Governorate.

sources.title: Tell el-Far'a archaeological research project
sources.institution: International project with Palestinian Ministry participation
sources.scope: Research identity and excavation history; no complete current condition or legally approved boundary dataset.

sources.title: Hosh Al-Atout — Al-Yasmina Quarter
sources.institution: Palestinian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities
sources.scope: Identity and restoration of one courtyard; cannot represent all buildings or the complete quarter boundary.

sources.title: The Shrine of Nabi Musa
sources.institution: Palestinian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities
sources.scope: Mamluk complex identity and major components; detailed dates, ownership and rights require inscriptions, Waqf and legal records.

sources.title: St. Barbara Church in Aboud
sources.institution: Palestinian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities
sources.scope: One component within the wider Aboud historic landscape.

sources.title: Dormition of the Theotokos Church — Al-Aboudieh
sources.institution: Palestinian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities
sources.scope: One multi-phase church component within Aboud.

sources.title: Deir Ammar
sources.scope: Confirms historic-centre identity but provides no complete public constituent inventory or GIS boundary.

sources.title: The Historic Centre of Gaza
sources.institution: State of Palestine submission published by UNESCO
sources.scope: Defines a proposed 1.7 km² historic centre; does not provide a complete 2026 integrity or engineering survey.

sources.title: Anthedon Harbour
sources.institution: State of Palestine submission published by UNESCO
sources.scope: Ancient harbour identity with explicit uncertainty over precise site identification; no current engineering severity assessment.

sources.title: Nablus City Story
sources.scope: Historic urban and mosque context; not a complete current condition inventory of every component.

sources.title: Nablus mosque damage report, 7 March 2025
